findings.detail: A responder packet was changed to disclose the hidden compact target, all uncommitted runtime hashes were rebound, and rev0384 still returned support-isolated-semantic-recovery-pilot.
The responder-bound commitment now fixes exact assignment-plan bytes, scoring-policy bytes, and one canonical complete responder-packet projection per arm before response.
Canonical strict JSON excludes only the packet's self-referential assignment_commitment_sha256 field; every other responder-visible field remains digest-bound.
The prefreeze collector recomputes the actual nested packet projection and rejects substitution before publishing the all-response lock.
Postfreeze verification and final aggregation independently revalidate every packet projection, dispatch row, response-lock row, and verification receipt.
Builder, lock, verifier, scorer, checker, and preflight now share oq0266_isolated_commitment_lib.py instead of maintaining partial commitment interpretations.
Packet, template, and bundle file hashes bind response finalization bytes but no longer stand in for evidence that the stimulus was selected preanswer.
Ordinary lint rebuilds a malicious responder bundle and matching finalized response, then requires rejection before response-set-lock publication.
No real four-responder isolated batch or conventional clean OQ-0266 triplet has been imported, and the commitment is not independently timestamped or signed.

non_claim: Internal reproduced defect and synthetic regression evidence only; not a clean external OQ-0266 result, trusted timestamp, identity proof, signed provenance, causal burden result, or canonical promotion.
